title: Logs
subtitle: Requests to {domain} and its PHP errors.
accessHelp: Each line: client, time, request, status, bytes, referrer, browser and milliseconds taken. The log rotates at 10 MB and keeps five old files.
phpHelp: PHP errors of every site this account owns. Sites made before this log existed keep logging where they did until their PHP pool is made again.
noWafLog: The firewall has not matched any request yet.
wafHelp: Requests the web application firewall matched: time, client, request, what it did (blocked, would-block or matched), the status it chose, and the rules. Only requests to PHP or an app are checked.
